# thrift-cpp / FuzzRoundtripBinary

thrift-cpp's own fuzz target `FuzzRoundtripBinary` ([source](source/FuzzRoundtripBinary.cpp), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over thrift (apache/thrift at 588053de).

Checks one property, a round trip: Parse a FuzzTest struct with TBinaryProtocol, serialize it back with the same protocol, re-parse the bytes, and require the two structs to be equal (generated operator==, every field incl. containers, unions, recursive struct); the only tolerance is NaN in basic.double_field.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against thrift at commit 588053de.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
